title: Turn 1 video into a week of posts

tweets.text:
You made one video.

Here's how it turns into a week of posts:

Most creators post the video and move on.

The ideas inside it never reach the people who don't watch long videos.
Step 1: Find the 3 to 5 ideas that work alone.
Step 2: Cut each idea into a short reel.

Step 3: Turn the best idea into a carousel.

→ One idea per slide
→ Big text, few words
→ A real screenshot as proof
→ A save-worthy last slide

Step 4: Write the long version once.

A blog post, a LinkedIn article and a newsletter can all come from the same draft.

Then put it all in one folder, with a plan for what goes where and when.

One video. Seven days of posts.

Save this for your next upload.
